title: Excellent Classical Guitarist
text: We attended an excellent classical guitar concert by Alvaro Munoz. He started with a piece from the Renaissance and worked his way forward chronologically. If you are looking for a guitar concert and see that he is performing somewhere, be sure to go.
author: ise277

title: Awe inspiring
text: José Maria Huertas was the musician performing on the evening we attended. It was the most memorable experience, my husband and I, a small subterranean room and José playing for us alone. We lucked out as no one else had booked. José had put together a one hour program celebrating classical/flamenco guitarists from Granada interlaced with other famous classical guitar pieces. With each new piece he introduced the composer and talked a little bit about the origins of the music. Sitting right in front of José we were able to feel the passion of his playing, watch in awe as his fingers moved deft
author: jbazs

title: Enjoyable Spanish Guitar concert
text: We enjoyed the concert and learning from Pablo about Spanish and Flemenco guitar playing.  We wish it could have been longer and we could have met him and thanked him after the performance.  Would definitely recommend to anyone interested in music.
author: gmyjby

title: Intensely moving music
text:
This recital, given by Alvaro Munoz, was hands down the most memorable part of my trip to Spain. It is seldom one has the opportunity to experience a talent such as this, especially in such an intimate setting.  Munoz's technique is flawless, but it is his command of musical expression that sets him apart. The music flows from his fingers into the guitar and takes you away.  We were also treated to some of his own intensely beautiful compositions. The recital  was interactive and informative and the artist was engaging.
I highly recommend you take in one of Alvaro Munoz's recitals while in Gra
author: R3383NCsheilaw

title: Fantastic guitar music
text:
This was a fabulous recital. The guitarist for that evening was Alvaro Munoz, an incredibly talented and personable young musician and composer. He led us from the Renaissance through to the Romantic periods of the guitar repertoire, at times interspersed with dazzling Flamenco styling. We were also treated to a number of his own compositions, which ranged from achingly beautiful to uplifting and exuberant. His technical precision was masterful but it was his artistry of musical expression that enchanted us.

title: Ten from ten points
text:
Admittedly, I was a bit skeptical when I booked the concert online via a mass portal before our holiday. But then my expectations were exceeded:
We were able to experience a beautiful and unforgettable guitar evening in an intimate atmosphere.
While the streets were crowded outside during the hustle and bustle of Semana Santa, and the cuantadores screamed their souls out of each other in the Cuevas, here we found a soothing place of rest. title: Listen and learn
text: Lovely experience. Learnt and listened in gentle surroundings with a musician who was interesting, gracious and talented.
author: Rosemary_M

title: It was a privilege to be 2 meters away from this guitarist
text: Very humble young man, I've been listening to flamenco players for the last 10 years, I've listened consistentlty to Pepe Habichuela, Tomatito, Jose del Tomate, VIcente Amigo, and many more, and Pablo Gimenez is right there ....  among them, his finesse is plesant. his timing and movement on the guitar takes it to a new dimension. My wife and I loved the one hour show.
author: fernandolP7693VO

title: Lovely guitar play, super-friendly host
text: We enjoyed an amazing evening of Spanish and flamenco guitar with Pablo. His music and guitar playing was exceptional but what really made it a five star experience was Pablo’s friendly and engaging commentary, and the time he took to explain his passion for music. Do not miss this experience 😊
author: DerekR1583

title: Very great program!
text: A very alternating program was played. Thanks to Pablo's explanations, I also understood better how the flamenco tradition works with dance and singing. Next time I will definitely come back!
